title: Interrupted frontend verification runs retained without credentials

runs.observed_failure: Read-only API fixture request GET /api/v1/operations/policies failed with ECONNRESET.
runs.service_log: Server started normally; no application traceback or error appeared; helper performed normal shutdown after the suite failed.
runs.cause: Undetermined local transport reset. Concurrent native packaging and backend tests were loading the shared host; resource pressure is a possibility, not a proven cause.
runs.handling: Retain failure; redact fixture credential in failure traces; rerun failed suite from a fresh synthetic database after host pressure subsides. No application retry, API behavior or workflow assertions were changed.
runs.credential_policy: Authorization values are not retained; a test-only trace-redaction gap was corrected before retry.
completed_check_names: Demo-only gate for extended synthetic workflows
Audited patient correction updates the real record and resets reminder consent on phone change
Private public RSVP removes fragment, requires review, and does not mark actual attendance
Disruption preview performs no write; confirmed change preserves original appointment time
Task ownership, callback time, resolution, and reopening persist with versioned actions
Explicit patient disruption decision resolves its staff case; block resolution remains separate

resolution.retry_changes: Test failure redaction only; no app/source/HTTP retry behavior or assertion change
resolution.interpretation: The read and full 13-check workflow passed on a fresh synthetic database. The original reset cause remains undetermined.

completed_check_names: Release control mutations require an explicit isolated demo
Five independent evidence references and explicit reviewer confirmation are required; changing mode clears the draft; no readiness is fabricated
Explicit owner confirmation publishes a versioned synthetic policy and does not claim live merchant settlement
Public mobile reception shows published safe terms, with no merchant identity or staff credential disclosure
Original policy values are restored through a new audited version
Latency panel shows actual bounded stage distributions and distinguishes them from first-audible caller latency
runs.observed_failure: Legacy test waited for the old settings draft heading and three setup cards after successful clinic creation.
runs.diagnosis: The implemented companion UX navigates to /setup with heading مرکز را آماده کنید and four saved-state steps. Screenshot, successful create response and App.tsx/Setup.tsx confirm intended new behavior; no application error was recorded.
runs.handling: Update the test to assert the new guide route, four incomplete steps, selected clinic, saved settings and unchanged inactive mode across reload; add desktop/320px audit of this changed guide. No app source or bundle changes.

resolution.interpretation: Complete release workflow passed on the final three-color corrected bundle, including saved four-step setup across reload and desktop/320px audits.
